title: Aging Schedule for Continuing Capitation Withholdings — Cascade DHMO Primary Care Dentist Agreement
content:
Under the **Network Participation Agreements**, a continuing capitation withholding on a Cascade DHMO Primary Care Dentist Agreement recovers an overpayment that is already under recovery. The share of the capitation payment withheld for it rises with the age of that overpayment.

**Clause.** The aging adjustment to the continuing capitation withholding share is set by how many days the overpayment under recovery is past its refund window:

- more than 60 days past adds one share point for every whole 5 days past the window;
- more than 30 and at most 60 days past adds a flat 5 share points;
- 30 days past or fewer adds nothing.

## Measuring "days past the window"

- **The overpayment under recovery** is the overpayment that the agreement's most recent withholding was applied to.
- **Days past the window** are the days from that overpayment's notice date to today, less the refund window of 45 calendar days that applies to every agreement type.
- **Counting days.** Days are calendar days counted from the earlier date to the later date: the earlier date is not counted and the later date is. Where two ledger entries share the latest date, the one listed first on the agreement's ledger is taken.
- **Points in the top band.** The share points are the number of whole 5-day periods in all the days past the window, not only in the days beyond 60. Any remainder of fewer than 5 days adds nothing.

## Band table

| Days past the refund window | Share points added |
|---|---|
| 30 or fewer | None |
| 31 to 60 | 5 |
| 61 or more | One per whole 5 days past the window |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical)

| Notice date to today | Days past the window | Points |
|---|---|---|
| 75 days | 30 | None |
| 76 days | 31 | 5 |
| 105 days | 60 | 5 |
| 106 days | 61 | 12 (12 whole periods of 5 days in 61) |
| 137 days | 92 | 18 |
